description.value: Tyax Lodge & Chalets is a remote wilderness lodge and wedding venue set on Tyaughton Lake in the Southern Chilcotin Range, north of Whistler near Gold Bridge, BC — a region well known for its mountain biking. The property offers lodge rooms, three self-catered private chalets (4-, 6-, and 9-bedroom), a campground, gourmet dining, a full spa, and heli-skiing, making it one of the more complete wilderness destinations in the BC interior. It has been nominated for Canada's Leading Wilderness Resort 2025 at the World Travel Awards.
